defective_pattern: Using verbose Persian phrases (e.g., میانگین) in table header cells instead of standard APA 7 Latin abbreviations.
why_defective: Violates APA 7 standard which dictates using universal statistical abbreviations (M, SD, p, etc.) in headers and defining them in a note.
observed_symptoms: Persian text like 'میانگین' or 'انحراف معیار' in table columns
corrective_remedy: Use standard APA 7 Latin abbreviations (M, SD, SE, t, F, p, z, B, β, df, R²) in headers. Provide definitions in the table note.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detecting verbose Persian statistical terms in table header syntax.
